assumptions.assumption_zh: 统筹研究范围43.6km²、总体设计范围11.4km²、重点区域368.4ha的面积数据来自官方资格预审公告，为文本描述值
assumptions.assumption_en: The area data of 43.6 km² coordinated research scope, 11.4 km² overall design scope, and 368.4 ha key areas are from the official pre-qualification announcement as text-described values
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 所有空间比例分析、密度计算均基于上述面积数据，精确边界公布后需重新核算
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: All spatial ratio analyses and density calculations are based on the above area data; recalculation required after exact boundary release
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 官方精确勘测定界成果、正式红线图

assumptions.assumption_zh: 三处重点片区（众智园192.1ha、AI原点104.3ha、大钟寺72.0ha）的具体空间范围根据官方文字描述概念性划定
assumptions.assumption_en: The specific spatial boundaries of the three key areas (Zhongzhiyuan 192.1ha, AI Origin 104.3ha, Dazhongsi 72.0ha) are conceptually delineated based on official text descriptions
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 三片区的功能定位、空间布局和指标分配为概念建议，精确边界确定后需调整
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Functional positioning, spatial layout, and indicator allocation for the three areas are conceptual proposals; adjustment required after exact boundary confirmation
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 官方发布的三处重点区域精确边界和面积

assumptions.assumption_zh: 京张铁路遗址公园呈南北向线性贯穿研究范围，宽度约35-40米（含绿化），长度约9公里
assumptions.assumption_en: The Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park runs north-south linearly through the research scope, with a width of approximately 35-40 meters (including greenery) and a length of about 9 km
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 对径式空间结构以遗址公园为核心组织要素，实际线位和宽度影响整体布局
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: The diameter spatial structure is organized around the heritage park; actual alignment and width affect overall layout
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 京张铁路遗址公园已实施段精确线位和宽度、规划控制线

assumptions.assumption_zh: 现状用地以科研教育、产业、居住和绿地为主，土地利用结构参考海淀区北三环-北五环区域一般特征
assumptions.assumption_en: Current land use is dominated by research & education, industry, residential, and green space; land use structure references typical characteristics of Haidian District's North 3rd-5th Ring Road area
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 用地潜力评估和更新改造策略基于一般性推断，需以实际用地调查为准
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Land potential assessment and renewal strategies are based on general inferences; actual land use survey should prevail
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 海淀区最新国土空间规划、现状用地普查数据

assumptions.assumption_zh: 重点片区现状建筑以多层和小高层为主，众智园片区建筑密度较低，AI原点片区建筑密度较高
assumptions.assumption_en: Existing buildings in key areas are mainly mid-rise and low high-rise; Zhongzhiyuan area has lower building density, AI Origin area has higher building density
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 建筑更新改造策略和开发强度建议基于概念性判断，不构成法定规划结论
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Building renewal strategies and development intensity recommendations are based on conceptual judgments and do not constitute statutory planning conclusions
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 现状建筑普查数据、建筑质量评定、权属调查

assumptions.assumption_zh: 重点设计区域内规划就业岗位约20-25万个，常住人口约12-15万人，职住比约1.5:1
assumptions.assumption_en: Planned employment in key design areas is approximately 200,000-250,000 jobs, resident population approximately 120,000-150,000, job-housing ratio approximately 1.5:1
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 人口与就业规模直接影响公共服务设施配置、交通承载力和住房供给估算
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Population and employment scale directly affect public service facility allocation, transportation capacity, and housing supply estimates
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 海淀区人口规划、控规人口容量、就业岗位统计

assumptions.assumption_zh: AI高端人才占核心区就业人口比例约30-40%，人才年龄结构以25-40岁青年为主
assumptions.assumption_en: AI high-end talent accounts for approximately 30-40% of core area employment, with talent age structure dominated by youth aged 25-40
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 人才社区设计、公共服务配置、文化设施需求均基于此人口特征假设
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Talent community design, public service configuration, and cultural facility needs are all based on this demographic assumption
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 海淀AI产业从业人员统计、人才结构调研数据

assumptions.assumption_zh: 现状轨道线路（13号线、10号线、15号线、昌平线）及站点位置保持稳定，不考虑新增轨道线路
assumptions.assumption_en: Existing rail transit lines (Line 13, Line 10, Line 15, Changping Line) and station positions remain stable; no new rail lines are assumed
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: TOD开发策略和站点一体化设计基于既有轨道条件，未来线网调整需同步更新
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: TOD development strategy and station integration design are based on existing transit conditions; future network adjustments require synchronization updates
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 北京市轨道交通线网规划（2020-2035年）、13号线扩能提升方案

assumptions.assumption_zh: 绿色出行比例目标85%基于国际先进城市对标，需要配套完善的慢行系统和公共交通支撑
assumptions.assumption_en: The 85% green travel share target is based on international advanced city benchmarks and requires supporting pedestrian/bicycle systems and public transit
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 交通系统设计以绿色出行为导向，道路空间分配优先保障步行和骑行
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Transportation system design is oriented toward green travel, with road space allocation prioritizing pedestrians and cycling
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 现状出行结构调查、交通需求预测模型、可达性分析

assumptions.assumption_zh: 国家「十五五」规划、北京「十五五」规划、海淀「1+X+1」产业体系等政策方向延续稳定，AI产业继续作为战略重点
assumptions.assumption_en: National 15th Five-Year Plan, Beijing 15th Five-Year Plan, and Haidian '1+X+1' industrial system policy directions remain stable, with AI industry continuing as a strategic priority
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 方案的产业定位、发展目标和实施路径以现有政策框架为基础，政策调整需相应修正
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: The proposal's industrial positioning, development goals, and implementation path are based on the current policy framework; policy adjustments require corresponding revisions
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 各级「十五五」规划正式发布文本、AI产业政策更新

assumptions.assumption_zh: 海淀区AI产业2026年基础规模约3500亿元，是方案设定2030年3000亿元核心产业增量目标的依据
assumptions.assumption_en: Haidian District's AI industry base scale in 2026 is approximately 350 billion RMB, serving as the basis for the proposal's 2030 target of 300 billion RMB core industry incremental goal
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 产业空间需求估算和开发强度建议基于该产业规模假设
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Industrial space demand estimates and development intensity recommendations are based on this industry scale assumption
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 海淀区AI产业统计年报、官方发布的产业规模数据

assumptions.assumption_zh: 大模型、具身智能、AI for Science等AI技术持续快速迭代，到2030年形成更成熟的应用场景
assumptions.assumption_en: AI technologies such as large models, embodied intelligence, and AI for Science continue to iterate rapidly, forming more mature application scenarios by 2030
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: AI原生场景设计和智能空间标准基于技术发展趋势预判，需动态跟进调整
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: AI-native scenario design and smart space standards are based on technology development trend predictions and require dynamic follow-up adjustments
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: AI技术路线图、产业技术成熟度评估、场景落地试点反馈

assumptions.assumption_zh: 算力需求持续增长，区域级智算中心（十万卡级）是支撑AI创新的必要基础设施
assumptions.assumption_en: Computing power demand continues to grow; regional intelligent computing centers (100K GPU card scale) are necessary infrastructure to support AI innovation
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 智算中心选址、电力供应、冷却系统等基础设施规划基于该假设
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Intelligent computing center siting, power supply, cooling system and other infrastructure planning are based on this assumption
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 算力需求测算、电力供应能力评估、智算中心布局规划

assumptions.assumption_zh: 自动驾驶、无人配送等技术到2030年达到L4级别在限定区域商业化运营的成熟度
assumptions.assumption_en: Autonomous driving, unmanned delivery and other technologies will reach L4 level maturity for commercial operation in designated areas by 2030
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 智能交通空间预留、无人配送设施布局等设计基于该技术成熟度假设
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Smart transportation space reservation, unmanned delivery facility layout and other designs are based on this technology maturity assumption
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 自动驾驶技术发展路线图、测试运营数据、相关法规政策

assumptions.assumption_zh: 「对径式」空间结构概念基于北京中轴对称的城市基因转译，是设计理念而非工程结论
assumptions.assumption_en: The 'Diameter' spatial structure concept is based on the translation of Beijing's central axis symmetry urban gene; it is a design concept rather than an engineering conclusion
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 整体空间组织结构和视觉秩序以对称为设计原则，需在深化阶段进行工程可行性验证
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Overall spatial organization structure and visual order use symmetry as design principle; engineering feasibility verification required in deepening phase
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 现状空间肌理分析、交通工程可行性研究、景观方案深化

assumptions.assumption_zh: 京张铁路遗址公园可作为复合型公共空间承载步行、骑行、活动、景观等多功能，而非单纯绿化带
assumptions.assumption_en: The Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park can serve as a composite public space carrying multiple functions such as walking, cycling, events, and landscape, rather than a mere green belt
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 对径断面设计和功能布局基于遗址公园的多功能利用假设
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: The diameter cross-section design and functional layout are based on the multi-functional utilization assumption of the heritage park
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 京张铁路遗址公园规划设计方案、绿地管理规定、文物保护要求

assumptions.assumption_zh: AI产业年均复合增长率保持15-20%，到2030年实现核心产业规模倍增
assumptions.assumption_en: AI industry maintains 15-20% CAGR, achieving core industry scale doubling by 2030
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 产业空间供给和办公建筑需求估算基于该增长率假设
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Industrial space supply and office building demand estimates are based on this growth rate assumption
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: AI产业增长预测、宏观经济形势分析、产业政策效果评估

assumptions.assumption_zh: 京张铁路沿线存在可利用的工业遗产资源（铁轨、站房、信号设施等），可用于文化展示和空间活化
assumptions.assumption_en: Industrial heritage resources (rail tracks, station buildings, signal facilities, etc.) along the Jing-Zhang Railway are available for cultural display and space activation
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 文化叙事和遗产活化设计基于该资源假设，实际遗存状况可能与描述有差异
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Cultural narrative and heritage activation design are based on this resource assumption; actual heritage conditions may differ from descriptions
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 京张铁路文物普查资料、工业遗产评估报告、文保单位清单

assumptions.assumption_zh: 小月河等水系保持现状走向和功能，可作为生态廊道和景观资源
assumptions.assumption_en: Water systems such as Xiaoyue River maintain their current alignment and function, serving as ecological corridors and landscape resources
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 东翼场景赋能翼的生态格局和空间布局以现有水系为参考
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: The ecological pattern and spatial layout of the east wing scenario empowerment wing reference the existing water system
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 北京市水系规划、蓝线管控要求、河道治理规划

assumptions.assumption_zh: 创新带建设采用政府引导+市场运作的混合模式，BID模式可在中国语境下本土化改造后适用
assumptions.assumption_en: Innovation belt construction adopts a government-guided + market-operated hybrid model; BID model can be applied after localized adaptation in the Chinese context
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 治理架构和运营机制设计基于该模式可行性假设，需政策制度创新支持
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Governance structure and operation mechanism design are based on this model feasibility assumption and require policy and institutional innovation support
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 国内园区治理模式案例研究、相关法规政策可行性、地方政府管理体制

assumptions.assumption_zh: 「十五五」期间（2026-2030年）可完成启动期和加速期建设，形成基本框架
assumptions.assumption_en: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period (2026-2030), start-up and acceleration phases can be completed, forming a basic framework
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 实施分期和行动计划基于该时间窗口假设，实际进度取决于资金、审批等多方面因素
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: Implementation phasing and action plans are based on this time window assumption; actual progress depends on funding, approvals, and other factors
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 政府投资计划、项目审批周期、征地拆迁进度、建设资金落实情况

assumptions.assumption_zh: 杨开忠新空间经济学的「空间品质驱动人才集聚、知识交流驱动创新增长」理论适用于海淀AI创新带的规划设计
assumptions.assumption_en: Yang Kaizhong's New Spatial Economics theory of 'spatial quality driving talent agglomeration, knowledge exchange driving innovation growth' is applicable to the planning and design of Haidian AI Innovation Belt
assumptions.impact_on_design_zh: 整个方案的理论基础和设计范式基于该适用性假设，空间品质七维度体系是核心设计工具
assumptions.impact_on_design_en: The entire proposal's theoretical foundation and design paradigm are based on this applicability assumption; the seven-dimension spatial quality system is the core design tool
assumptions.data_needed_to_verify: 新空间经济学实证研究、AI创新区空间品质与创新产出相关性研究
